title: 1921 During the reconstruction of the bridge, an ice bridge was used
description: An unidentified woman stands cheerfully on the newly constructed narrow boardwalk along the western span, which was being replaced. Behind her, the ice bridge is visible, marked by sleigh tracks left by locals who used it each winter to cross the frozen river. Small fir trees lined the track, guiding travellers safely across during snowstorms. (Photo courtesy of Inez Roy)
